4833: City of Jacksonville equestrian center at 13611 Normandy Blvd, run since 2014 by the non-profit Northeast Florida Equestrian Society.  Its RV lots, where no horses are allowed, have 30/50-amp full-hookup sites, some pull-through, 50-amp water-and-electric overflow sites and primitive sites, each listed at 40 ft.  An outside restroom with showers by the main arena is open around the clock, and there is a dump station; swimming and fishing are prohibited on the property. --Claude
5088: Small campground on a meadow at 20450 Old Hwy 80, Edwards, between the Black River, a fishing pond, a farm and a forest, reached by an unlit dirt road off I-20's exit 19: 30/50-amp RV sites on grass and gravel, pull-throughs among them, plus primitive RV and tent sites.  There are hot showers and flush toilets but no dump station, the nearest being 8 miles away; the river and pond can be fished without a license, and the river kayaked.  Its Hipcamp listing no longer takes bookings. --Claude
5119: RV park in Hattiesburg with full-hookup 30- and 50-amp sites, Wi-Fi, a laundry, a dump station and a picnic area; it takes no cash, and guests may stay as long as they like. --Claude
5818: Family-owned campground on 43 acres of grass and shade trees along Bulldog Creek, at I-90's exit 37 five minutes from Sturgis, with trails behind it into 700-plus miles of motorized trails: 30/50-amp full-hookup sites, all-weather 50-amp pull-throughs, water-and-electric and dry sites, tent sites, cabins and tiny homes.  There are showers, a laundry, a dump station, and a bar and café open to the public. --Claude
5831: Quiet 40-site campground on SD-109 just north of Big Stone City, near Big Stone Lake and a boat launch: back-in and pull-through sites with 30- or 50-amp full hookups, each with a picnic table and fire ring.  There is a newly renovated shower and laundry building, a dump station and a playground, and a cabin for rent. --Claude
5990: Lisbon Park District park on the Sheyenne River, open April 1 to November 14: a West Campground of full-hookup sites and a North Campground behind the FEMA dike with electric and water, every site wired for 20, 30 and 50 amps, plus primitive camping on the grass.  The campground is self-service: hookup sites must be reserved and paid ahead, while primitive sites are first come, first served.  There are showerhouses and a dump station, and the park has an outdoor pool, mini golf, a skate park, ball fields and courts. --Claude
6033: Barnes County's 27-acre park in the hills along the Sheyenne River, 4 miles south and 1 mile east of Kathryn on Highway 46, on the Sheyenne River Valley National Scenic Byway, open May 1 to October 31: 34 campsites, 16 with electric and 18 more secluded primitive sites in the upper part of the park, suited to tents and small campers.  Every site must be reserved, for a week at most.  There are three concrete vault toilets, rural water for filling tanks, a dump station, a playground, and hiking trails with footbridges over a spring-fed stream. --Claude
6758: RV park within Woodward's city limits at 1304 Enterprise Ave, with paved full-hookup 30/50-amp sites, free Wi-Fi, a coin laundry and a propane bottle exchange; monthly stays pay for their own electricity. --Claude
6779: RV park in Laverne next to the Laverne Golf & Country Club: 13 pull-through sites with full 30/50-amp hookups, big enough for any RV, and Wi-Fi.  Check-in is around the clock at a self-service booth, and payment is by cash, check or card on arrival; there are restrooms with showers and a public dump station. --Claude
7365: Private primitive park at 2009 N Apache Road near Van Horn, on high-desert land reached by a graded dirt road a normal vehicle can drive: RV and tent sites with fire rings and drinking water, but no hookups, dump station or other facilities.  Call an hour ahead, and someone will escort you to your site. --Claude
7380: RV park inside Bay City's city limits at 1803 Horn Rd, fenced on three sides, with 43 full-hookup 30/50-amp sites on concrete pads, some for rigs up to 52 ft, free Wi-Fi, restrooms and showers, and a coin laundry.  It also rents two studios, and markets itself to workers at the area's plants as well as to travelers. --Claude
7382: Gated RV park in San Leon, two blocks from Galveston Bay and just off I-45, with 144 level concrete full-hookup sites, 20/30/50-amp, back-ins 30 by 65 ft and pull-throughs 30 by 75 ft, cable TV at the deluxe sites and free Wi-Fi at all of them.  There are two bath and shower houses, two coin laundries, a clubhouse and a fenced dog park, but no pool. --Claude
7391: RV park on 22 wooded acres within Beeville's city limits at 610 N Archer, under new ownership: full-hookup 30/50-amp sites with Wi-Fi and free satellite TV.  There are restrooms and showers, a laundry, a playground, a basketball court, an exercise and game room, pavilions, barbecue pits and a private catch-and-release fishing lake. --Claude
7401: RV park at 1630 Wheeler Road between Amarillo and Canyon, off Washington St, 15 minutes from Palo Duro Canyon State Park: full-hookup 20/30/50-amp sites, 40-ft back-ins and 72-ft pull-throughs, with Wi-Fi and a laundry.  RVs must be self-contained, and tents aren't allowed. --Claude
